risks.note: Management explicitly flags procurement timelines, installation and commissioning schedules, availability of utilities, regulatory approvals, cost escalations and market conditions while the project is under implementation. Commercial production is only expected in Q4 FY2026-27, and every forward statement in the MD&A is conditioned on successful commissioning, so slippage in any of these directly delays the diversification the Board is relying on.
risks.risk: Project execution risk on the MCT Oil plant - the company's entire growth case rests on an asset that is not yet built

risks.note: MCT Oil is manufactured primarily from coconut oil and palm kernel oil, and volatility in their prices is named both as a threat and as a monitored business risk. Because the feedstock is a traded agri-commodity and the output is sold into quality-regulated end markets, input swings hit margin before they can be passed through. Mitigation stated is strategic sourcing and inventory planning.
risks.risk: Raw material price volatility in coconut oil and palm kernel oil

risks.note: Listed by management among the key business risks it continuously monitors. No customer count or share of revenue is disclosed anywhere in the report, so the degree of dependence cannot be sized from this annual report - the risk is acknowledged but unquantified.

Foreign exchange fluctuation is named as a monitored risk and, separately, as a threat that affects export competitiveness. The strategy explicitly depends on increasing exports to North America, Europe and Asia-Pacific, so currency moves bear on both realisation and price position against global suppliers.
risks.risk: Foreign exchange exposure and export competitiveness

risks.note: Regulatory compliance in domestic and export markets is a stated risk, and stringent international food safety and pharmaceutical quality standards are a stated threat. The company itself frames GMP, HACCP, FSSC 22000 and ISO compliance as something still to be strengthened rather than already held, which makes qualification for regulated export markets a gating condition on the export strategy.
risks.risk: Regulatory compliance and stringent international food-safety / pharmaceutical quality standards

risks.note: Increasing competition from global manufacturers is named as a threat. Crestchem is entering the specialty lipid market as a new producer with no commissioned capacity, so it will meet incumbents with existing scale, accreditations and customer approvals.
risks.risk: Competition from established global manufacturers in a market the company has not yet entered

risks.note: Named as a threat. Relevant on both sides of an export-oriented specialty ingredients model: imported or traded oleochemical feedstock inbound, and international shipping outbound to the North America, Europe and Asia-Pacific markets the company targets.
risks.risk: Supply chain disruption and freight cost fluctuation

risks.note: Both are named among the key business risks management monitors. Geopolitical disruption bears on the export-led growth plan; technological change bears on a process business whose competitive position rests on producing high-purity and customised MCT grades.
risks.risk: Geopolitical uncertainty affecting international trade, plus technological change
